PAC-MAN - 42 PROJECT
====================

RULES:
- Use Arrow Keys or <W,A,S,D> to move Pac-Man.
- Eat everything you can.
- Beat the 10 levels

CONFIGURATION:

- Only work on linux

Launch the game with the command : ./pac-man config.json
To launch the game be sure the executable is in the same directory than assets folder.

You can edit the "config.json" file to change the number of lives, the random seed, or the score values and more.
